title: Local synthetic alert routing preview
buyerProblem: Show how critical agent signals could reach the right team with evidence.
behaviour: The adapter saves a session-scoped routing preview over immutable synthetic trace snapshots. A per-event ERROR span or failed-trace count threshold computes a match, evidence and a hypothetical Slack, email or in-app destination for a fictional role. Matched delivery is labelled simulated; no notification is sent.
limitations: No outbound message, contact lookup, connection, live alert, timer or hosted rule is created.
Fictional Engineering on-call, Quality reviewer and Product owner roles are demo choices, not verified Neatlogs owner routing.
Cooldown is stored configuration only; thresholds count saved failure outcomes, not a monitored production time window.
Dataset edits flag previews stale; a new preview must be created against the current dataset.

planAvailability.note: Hosted access and ordinary plan entitlements were not verified; local synthetic behavior proves neither.

sources.claim: Strict local routing inputs, immutable snapshot evidence, idempotency and saved readback; no hosted imports or dispatch.
